svg.title: Drivable safety and limitations desktop explainer
svg.desc: A desktop concept instructing users to stop evidence collection for danger signals, collect written details only when safely parked, and understand Drivable's limits.
svg.text: Do not take a risk, recreate a symptom, or wait for Drivable when qualified or emergency help may be needed.

g.text: STOP USING THE VEHICLE AND SEEK APPROPRIATE HELP FOR A POSSIBLE IMMEDIATE THREAT
Examples include fire or smoke; fuel odor or leak; severe overheating; loss of braking or steering;
wheel or tire structural risk; electrical hazard; severe instability; or loss of power in traffic.
Contact emergency services or a qualified professional as appropriate. This list is not exhaustive.
Never type, record, photograph, or connect equipment while driving.
Do not recreate a symptom for a report, photo, or recording.
Do not approach moving, hot, energized, pressurized, or unsupported parts.
“I cannot provide this safely” is an acceptable evidence response.
Provide emergency service or monitor a vehicle in real time.
Replace a physical inspection or qualified in-person diagnosis.
Declare a vehicle safe, roadworthy, repaired, or ready to drive.
A possible cause or confidence label never overrides warning signs or judgment.

svg.text: IF CONDITIONS MAY BE DANGEROUS, STOP COLLECTION AND SEEK APPROPRIATE HELP
Target safety messaging concept—not a capture of the current live application.
